components.baseline: community baseline runtime, tokenizer, landmark and feature models unchanged from the parent bundle; translator weights fine-tuned (see translator)

inference_sha256_definition: sha256 over '<path>\0<sha256>\n' for umi_inference.py, umi_fs_router.py, fs_router.json, umi_fs/legacy_extractor.py, umi_fs/keypoints.py, umi_fs/fingerspelling.py, runtime.py, models/checkpoint-11625/model.safetensors
name: UMI Community Baseline v0.2, FLEURS-ASL fine-tuned translator + FSboard fingerspelling router (rc5)

router.inputs: the input video and the baseline's own answer only
router.stage1: use the fingerspelling component iff (confidence >= 0.9 AND >= 10 letters/digits) OR (confidence >= 0.85 AND >= 16 letters/digits) (confidence = mean non-blank CTC emission probability)
router.stage2: after the baseline answers: if its answer is at most 6 words and contains a digit, and the fingerspelling text has confidence >= 0.83 and >= 8 letters/digits, use the fingerspelling text
